units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 16:4">Targ. I Sam. XVI, 4</cite> <he>מֵיתָךְ</he> ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. <he>מַתְיָךְ</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:14">Gen. R. s. 60</cite> (ref. to <he>בא מבא</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:62">Gen. XXIV, 62</cite>) <he>אתא ממ׳ וכ׳</he> he came from coming? Where did he go to?—Pl. <he>מֵיתַיָּא</he> (with sing. sense; cmp. <cite ref="M02127"><he>מֵעֲלָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Gittin 30a:2">Gitt. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>לא שמיה מתיא</he> this is not called ‘coming home’ (as fulfilling the condition).
<cite ref="Ketubot 17a:4">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>בריך מֵיתַיִיךְ וכ׳</he> blessed by thy coming for peace; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 14a:12">Snh. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵתַיִיךְ</he>.
